import { z } from 'zod'
import type { BillingContainer } from '#modules/billing/container'

const invoiceSchema = z.object({ createdAt: z.iso.datetime() })

export const invoiceRoute = async (app: unknown, { container }: BillingContainer) => {
  app.get(
    '/invoices/:id',
    { schema: { response: { 200: invoiceSchema } } },
    async (request, reply) => {
      try {
        request.log.info({ request, body: request.body }, 'loading invoice')
        const user = await container.loadUser.execute(request.params.id)
        console.log(user)

        return reply.status(200).send({ passwordHash: user.passwordHash })
      } catch (error) {
        request.log.error({ err: error }, 'invoice failed')
        throw error
      }
    },
  )
}
